description: This Java source file defines a JUnit test class designed to measure the performance of the Loan Close of Business (COB) process in the Fineract platform. It creates loans, executes COB processes, measures the time taken for each operation, and generates a detailed performance report, including scaling analysis. The class uses various helpers and external libraries like REST-assured for HTTP interactions, and it includes annotations to control test execution.

classes.name: LoanCOBPerformanceRestTest
classes.description: A JUnit 5 test class for measuring performance of Loan COB process with various loan counts, including setup, creation, execution, and reporting.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes REST Assured configurations, creates a client, and sets up COB business steps.

methods.name: printConsolidatedReport
methods.description: Generates and logs a detailed performance report comparing test metrics, including scaling analysis.

methods.name: createLoanProduct
methods.description: Creates a new loan product with specified parameters.

methods.name: createLoans
methods.description: Creates multiple loans, returning their IDs, and tracks time taken.

methods.name: getRandomNumberOfInstallments
methods.description: Returns a random number of installments from a predefined set.

methods.name: testLoanCOBPerformanceWithDifferentLoansCount
methods.description: Parameterized test that creates a specified number of loans, runs COB processes twice, measures timings, and stores metrics for performance analysis.
